x-changelog.summary: Accept a rules-of-credit tree on create when claiming schemes are enabled
x-changelog.description:
When claiming schemes are enabled, create accepts optional `components` or
`scheme` (not both). A malformed tree returns 422. These fields are ignored
when claiming schemes are off. The tree is not returned in the response.

x-changelog.summary: Corrected quantity validation when creating a Budgeted Production Quantity
x-changelog.description:
An existing bug allowed BPQs to be created with negative quantities and absurdly large values,
both of which have been corrected.

'quantity' must now be greater than or equal to 0 and must round to an absolute value less
than 1,000,000,000.00. Values outside that range are rejected with a 422 instead of being
stored.

On a project that tracks production by rules of credit, a quantity carrying more than two
decimal places is rounded to two on save rather than stored at full precision, so the value
matches what Production Tracking holds.
